purpose: Engineering calibration of clocks, raw-request queue boundaries and same-slot normal first-mask probes; no cancellation or resource-harm claim.

for_each_width: wait for A started notification without holding A
submit B width1, even if A already finished

operation_scope.job: raw schema JSON validation -> conversion/compile -> fresh matcher -> first mask for token123 -> return primitive result, release request-local objects -> work_end

measurements.b_overlap: observed only when B_submitted < A_work_finished; otherwise unobserved, no retry
measurements.cpu_attribution: thread CPU excludes helper threads; process CPU includes controller/helper overhead; do not call either pure algorithm cost
measurements.rss: current RSS before baseline/after completed pair; allocator retention and high-water RSS do not prove leaks or OS reclaim
measurements.external_sampler: 10ms for ownership/liveness/cleanup, not per-call CPU accounting

stop_rules: schema/matcher/first-mask error or root token not admitted
unobserved_overlap_policy: Keep unobserved; no width escalation, repeats, sleeps or artificial work to force a signal.
